summary: Added standupActivityWindowFor (exported via @agile/contracts, which now re-exports date-rules), shared body-limit helpers in the api package (auth.ts moved onto them), optional RouteDefinition.bodyLimitBytes applied in registerRoute after authorization, and the @agile/core lockProjectForMutation export.
commit: see git log (feat: add the standup window, shared body limit and core lock export (W9))

produces.name: standupActivityWindowFor(date: string, now: Date): { from: Date; to: Date }
produces.note: from = 00:00 SGT of last Mon-Fri day before date; to = now; from >= to means empty

produces.name: readLimitedBody(request, maxBytes): Promise<{tooLarge:true}|{tooLarge:false;text:string}>
produces.note: streamed byte count; exactly maxBytes accepted

produces.name: RouteDefinition.bodyLimitBytes?: number
produces.note: registerRoute reads body via readLimitedBody after authorization; 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
